# Copilot instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` at the repository root first. It lists a mandatory open task: the UI was designed for portrait phones only, and the next UI work must start with a landscape-mode redesign.

Before creating or changing any screen, component, or button, read [`docs/design-principles.md`](../docs/design-principles.md). Reuse the existing ivory cloth, cream surfaces, warm dashed borders, restrained print shadow, Dahyun 400 font, and SVG icon system. The place-sheet close button follows the `.preview-map-button` material, consistently in map and list views; distinguish a 16–18px glyph from a minimum 44px touch target. Keep focus, pressed, disabled, and safe-area behavior intact.

Check [`docs/visual-theme.md`](../docs/visual-theme.md) for approved asset uses. Do not repurpose supplied originals without authorization. Respect the user's approved scope; a targeted button fix does not complete the outstanding landscape redesign.
